Thanks for the report. A log is much more useful than a description on its own. Please fill in every section.

## Port version

The first line of `fnv.log`, for example `fnv_recomp v37`.

## PS5 system software

The version in Settings > System > System Software, for example 13.42.

## What happened

What you saw.

## What you were doing

Where you were in the game, and what you pressed or changed just before it.

## Does it happen again?

Every time, only once, or only in some places.

## Logs

Attach `fnv.log` and, if it is there, `_d3d9.log`. Both are in the app folder:

`/data/homebrew/PPSA97701/`

`_d3d9.log` is the graphics log. It is not always created.

## Please leave these out

A report is public.

- Do not attach game files, or saves you do not want to be public.
- Do not post personal details: your name, email, IP address, or a console or account ID. Read the log before you attach it.
